answer: An honest agent completes 1 unit of unique, verifiable task-work to join the economy, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units to avoid detection, ensuring labor costs remain non-amortizable. The verifier treats each assignment like a garden of non-overlapping states, rejecting any output that duplicates a historical record. We require every quill to sign the input/output transition, which is then mapped to a ledger to prevent replay. This creates a safe haven where invalid proof transitions trigger permanent identity termination without any refund.
